schema.description: STILO MONT is a reliable partner for manufacturing cooperation and outsourcing of manual processes.

hero.description: STILO MONT is your reliable partner for manufacturing cooperation and outsourcing of manual processes. We take over assembly, completion and rework. Get stable output without staffing worries and hidden HR costs.

services.heading: Our services: Which processes we can take over

items.title: Manual assembly and completion
items.fullDesc: Professional assembly of products from multiple parts, precise gluing, folding and riveting. Our capacity is ideal for automotive, electrical industry, toys, and consumer goods where high manual precision is required.

items.title: Finishing and rework
items.fullDesc: Detailed trimming of plastic parts, burr removal after molding, visual and mechanical quality checks, and precise sorting. We help protect your production from defects and prepare parts for smooth next-stage processing.

items.title: Packing, repacking and co-packing
items.fullDesc: Comprehensive packing services including completion of gift and promo packs, insertion of printed manuals and flyers, product labeling, and final preparation for safe palletizing and dispatch.

process.heading: How cooperation works (step by step)
process.description: Our process is designed to reduce the burden on your company. We work in dedicated monitored premises under strict quality control.

steps.title: Analysis and sampling
steps.desc: Send us reference samples, drawings and required quality standards. We quickly run a time study and provide transparent per-piece pricing.

steps.title: Logistics
steps.desc: You deliver material or semi-finished products to our secure external facilities. If needed, we can arrange transportation using our own vehicles.

steps.title: Processing and control
steps.desc: Our dedicated operators complete agreed work exactly on time. Internal inspectors continuously monitor quality, standards and procedures.

steps.title: Dispatch of finished work
steps.desc: We return precisely processed, checked and securely packed output to your production line, or directly to your end customer by agreement.

benefits.heading: Why choose cooperation with STILO MONT
benefits.description: We are not a staffing agency. We do not supply headcount, we deliver finished work. These are the key reasons why our outsourcing model improves your efficiency.

card1.title: Stability and zero turnover
card1.description: Our operator team is stable. You avoid production outages caused by sick leave or employee departures.

card2.title: Pay for results, not hours
card2.description: You pay only the agreed price per completed piece or fulfilled standard. No payroll burden, leave coverage, sick pay or expensive downtime.

card3.title: Immediate scalability
card3.description: Need sudden extra capacity or a large order? We can quickly allocate, train and deploy a dedicated operator team for your project.

benefits.esgDescription: We focus on precision, protection of your know-how and safety of entrusted assets. Our operations follow strict safety standards.
benefits.esgText: By working with STILO MONT, you gain a reliable supplier and a strong partner for CSR and ESG reporting targets.

contact.heading: Looking for a reliable partner?
contact.description: Do not let your orders stall. Contact us and find out what manufacturing cooperation options we can offer your business.
